title: The Makenzie House

services.name: space rental
services.desc: The Makenzie House has hosted over two dozen proposals since opening, making it one of South Houston's most sought-after spots to get engaged. The 600 sq ft glass studio and fenced 2-acre yard give you the flexibility to keep it private or surround yourselves with the people who matter most. Whether you want a candlelit setup for two or a full surprise with family and friends present, this space fits your vision. You bring your vendors, your flowers, your vision. The space does the rest. Rent the glasshouse by the hour and make it yours. Outside vendors are welcome at no additional charge or we can match you with our preferred vendors for a stress-free experience.
